paragraphs: The aims of the photo journal project are to take one or two pictures a day to create a journal of the world around me.

I started with an Instax Mini 90 as it provided an instant print that I could catalogue. I really enjoyed the format of film both for it's look and how it's shot. I later switched to using 35 mm film as it wasn't as limiting as Instax but not as convinient as digital.

Currently the rules for the project are to shoot 1 roll of 36 exposures in a month. Therefore, on some days I will need to take two photos. There are not rules on what the photo can be or if it has to be a completely original shot the important thing is to just take a photo without overthinking the result.
To help track which photo was taken on which day I make a note of what photo was taken each day but sometimes I might write a haiku depending on if I feel like it.
